jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About us

ebiscon is a software development and IT consulting company with offices in Cologne and Athens. We analyse our customers' business processes and develop tailor-made digital solutions for them – web and mobile applications, cloud services on Microsoft Azure, e-commerce solutions with Shopware and Salesforce solutions.

Most of our customers are mid-size companies in Germany, from industries such as e-commerce, retail, laboratory supply and e-mobility. We support them from the first idea through development to ongoing operation, and often work with them for many years. In addition, we develop our own software platform for the e-mobility market.

Your role

You will mainly work for one of our key customers: a leading European group in laboratory supply and wholesale.

As a (Senior) Software Engineer, you take ownership of your topics: from understanding the requirement to a solution that runs reliably in production. You do not wait for someone to tell you what to do next – you drive your topics forward, make decisions within your area and stand behind the result. From time to time, you will also support our own e-mobility platform.

We work AI-first. Most of our code is no longer written by hand but generated with AI coding agents such as Claude Code – based on clear specifications and verified by you before it goes live. Your value lies less in typing code than in understanding the problem, steering the AI precisely and judging whether the result is correct, secure and maintainable.

Your responsibilities

Take full responsibility for your topics – from the requirement to production and beyond
Understand the business processes behind a requirement and raise questions or concerns early
Turn requirements into clear specifications and implement them with AI coding agents
Review AI-generated code thoroughly – security, authorization, data exposure, error handling – and only merge what you fully understand
Design backend services, APIs and integrations with C# / .NET, e.g. between e-commerce, ERP and logistics systems
Estimate and commit to your tasks in grooming and deliver them reliably – and speak up early if a commitment is at risk
Present your results in the regular reviews with the project team and the customer
Take part in code reviews and work according to our engineering standards (clean architecture, automated testing, CI/CD, secure development)
Keep technical documentation up to date and support releases

Your profile

At least 5 years of professional experience in backend development with C# / .NET (ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core)
Experience in building and operating production systems
Hands-on experience with AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as your primary way of developing – and a clear sense of where not to trust them
You take ownership: you have driven topics independently and are used to being accountable for the result
Solid knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL or SQL Server) and REST APIs
Experience with integrating third-party systems such as ERP, PIM or logistics systems
Good understanding of automated testing, CI/CD and secure software development
Experience with Docker and cloud platforms, ideally Microsoft Azure
Ability to explain technical topics clearly to non-technical people
Structured, independent way of working and clear written communication
Fluent English; German is a plus

Nice to have

Experience with B2B e-commerce, wholesale or order management processes
Shopware experience
Experience in an IT services or agency environment
Salesforce integrations
Azure certifications
Front-end experience with a modern framework

Working model

Hybrid work in Athens
Agreed core hours for team and customer meetings
Occasional travel to Cologne, e.g. for project kick-offs

What we offer

Long-term work for a key customer, with real influence on their systems
A high degree of responsibility and direct contact with the management
Flexible working hours
Monthly meal vouchers
Annual learning budget for training, certifications and AI tools

How to apply

Please apply via LinkedIn or send your CV together with your salary expectations and notice period to career@ebiscon.de.

jobs.title: Software Technical Director | Profile Software
jobs.description:
The Software Technical Director
is a senior technical leader responsible for defining the technology vision, overseeing the architecture and guiding the implementation of enterprise-grade public sector software solutions. This role combines deep hands-on expertise in (Java) backend development with strong proficiency in modern frontend frameworks such as ReactJS and Angular.
  What will you need to do:

Projects, Customer-Facing & Pre-Sales Engagement :
·       Support sales teams in technical discovery, RFP responses, and solution pitching.
·       Present technical solutions and architecture proposals to clients in meetings, workshops and executive-level discussions.
·       Build strong relationships by translating complex technical concepts into business value.
·        Collaborate with project managers and stakeholders.
·        Oversee project timelines, resource planning, and risk management.
·        Ensure high-quality delivery through automation, CI/CD, and testing strategies.

Technical Leadership & Architecture:
·       Define and maintain the overall technical architecture for backend and frontend systems.
·       Lead architectural design for scalable, secure, and high-performance applications.
·       Evaluate and select technology stacks, frameworks, tools, and coding standards.
·       Convert projects' requirements into actionable technical requirements.
·       Ensure consistent application of design patterns, microservices principles, and REST/SOAP API best practices.
·       Oversee backend development using Java, Spring Boot, Quarkus, and related technologies.
·       Drive improvements in performance, security, and maintainability of backend services.
·       Design and optimize database schemas, data flow, and integration points.
·       Lead efforts in system modernization, refactoring, and cloud adoption.
·       Provide technical oversight for applications built with ReactJS and Angular.
·       Establish reusable UI components, state management patterns, and architecture best practices.
·       Ensure consistent UX, responsive design, and accessibility compliance.
·       Ensure adherence to cybersecurity best practices.
·       Conduct code reviews and enforce engineering best practices.
·       Champion automated testing, code quality metrics, and DevOps principles.
·       Implement monitoring, logging, and observability standards.

Team Leadership & Mentorship:
·       Lead and mentor engineering teams.
·       Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
·       Guide career growth and skill development.

Requirements

·        Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field.
·        10+ years
of software engineering experience.
·        5+ years
in senior leadership roles, guiding engineering teams and managing complex projects.
·        Experience presenting solutions to customers and executives.
·        Expert proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and REST API design.
·        Strong experience with React, Angular, and modern frontend architectures.
·        Understanding of cloud platforms and containerization.
·        Experience in Defense projects

Benefits

What We Offer:

·       Competitive remuneration package
·       Medical & Life Insurance Plan
·       Experiences within a multinational environment and global teams
·       Team spirit environment with passion for technology
·       Development opportunities within a market-leading, fast-growing organization

If you want to be part of one of the top leading software firms in the FinTech industry internationally, we want to hear from you!

  We are an equal opportunities employer. All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality. By submitting your CV, you accept the content of our Privacy Policy
, and consent to the processing of your data as part of this application.

jobs.title: Fullstack .Net/Angular Developer
jobs.description:
Woonpartners
is een Vlaamse dochteronderneming van Cipal Schaubroeck die softwareoplossingen ontwikkelt en beheert voor sociale huisvesting, gevestigd in Bissegem (Kortrijk). Met onze eigen ERP-toepassing ondersteunen we woonmaatschappijen bij het beheer van panden, huurders, financiële processen en communicatie met Wonen in Vlaanderen.
Als Fullstack .Net/Angular Developer werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling, optimalisatie en onderhoud van deze uitgebreide applicatie. Je combineert jouw technische expertise met een sterk analytisch vermogen om de behoeften van onze gebruikers en stakeholders te begrijpen en te vertalen naar efficiënte oplossingen.

Wat wordt er van jou verwacht?

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden reiken verder dan louter ontwikkelen, testen en onderhouden van de software. Ook jouw analytisch inzicht komt goed van pas voor het vertalen van de businessnoden naar haalbare en gebruiksvriendelijke oplossingen. Zie je ergens verbeterkansen? In samenwerking met de projectmanager en consultants kom je tot optimalisatie van bestaande systemen. Je denkt actief mee over innovatie en bent AI-minded.

Jouw profiel

Bachelor- of masterdiploma in IT, Informatica of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
Minstens enkele jaren ervaring als Fullstack .Net/Angular Developer.
Grondige kennis van: .Net 8+ en/of .Net Framework 4.6+, Angular 21+, MS SQL Server 2019+, Entity Framework 6+ en EF Core, en versiebeheer via Git
Sterk analytisch denkvermogen en probleemoplossende vaardigheden.
Je begrijpt bedrijfsprocessen en kunt complexe vraagstukken structureren.
Je bent een teamplayer, maar kan eveneens goed zelfstandig werken.
Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands.

Pluspunten:

Ervaring met integraties met overheidsdiensten zoals Magda
Ervaring met Jenkins, Gradle, SonarQube, Renovate, DTrack, Nexus en Grafana

Waarom werken bij Woonpartners?

Bij Woonpartners werk je in een nichemarkt met grote maatschappelijke relevantie
. Je ondersteunt sociale woonmaatschappijen bij hun kernopdracht: het toewijzen, beheren en financieel opvolgen van sociale woningen. Je komt terecht in een klein maar dynamisch team waar samenwerking, kennisdeling en persoonlijke groei centraal staan.

Wat wij bieden?

Een uitdagende omgeving in volle transitie waar jij je steentje mee kan aan bijdragen.
De nodige licenties om je te laten ondersteunen door AI
.
Een gezonde work-life balance
met de nodige flexibiliteit en mogelijkheid tot hybride werken.
Een marktconform salaris,
aangevuld met maaltijdcheques, groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering, bedrijfswagen of fietsleasing, gsm-abonnement
40-urenweek met 12 ADV-dagen

Een stabiele werkomgeving
met een fijne groep teamplayers!

jobs.title: Senior Software Verification Engineer
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Senior Software Verification Engineer
who is passionate about software quality, automation and technical excellence. This is more than a testing role.

You will be a trusted technical leader who helps ensure our products are reliable, safe and ready for release, while driving the future of verification and test automation across our engineering teams.

If you enjoy solving complex technical problems, building scalable automation frameworks and influencing engineering decisions through evidence and expertise, we'd love to hear from you.

What you will do

As a Senior Software Verification Engineer
, you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring the quality of innovative software products from concept through to release.

You will:

Shape the verification strategy for complex software features, releases and product areas.
Design and implement robust automated tests that provide confidence in product quality.
Challenge requirements early to ensure they are clear, testable and aligned to customer needs.
Investigate complex defects, system behaviours and quality risks.
Partner closely with Software Engineers, Product Owners, DevOps, Quality and Technical Leaders to deliver high-quality solutions.
Use your expertise to influence release readiness decisions and product risk management.
Help evolve our automation frameworks, tools and engineering practices to support faster, smarter and more effective verification.
Create formal reports of the verification results
Review test code changes from developers

Drive the future of test automation

Automation is at the heart of this role.

You'll have the opportunity to design and enhance automated verification solutions using C++, C#, Python, PowerShell and other modern technologies
, improving both the speed and confidence of software delivery.
You'll work on scalable frameworks, CI/CD integration and advanced testing approaches that support high-quality product development in a highly regulated environment.

Lead through expertise

This role offers the opportunity to become a recognised technical leader without moving into formal people management.
You'll mentor and coach fellow engineers, review verification approaches, promote best practices and help raise the technical capability of the wider team.
Your ability to influence, collaborate and make sound engineering judgments will be just as important as your technical skills.

What you'll bring

We're interested in talented engineers who combine strong software verification expertise with a passion for continuous improvement.

You'll bring:

Significant experience in software verification and quality engineering.
A strong background in test automation and automated framework development.
Experience with C++ and/or C# and the ability to understand production software.
Knowledge of scripting languages such as Python or PowerShell.
Experience designing and executing complex software verification activities.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly when investigating defects and system failures.
Experience working with CI/CD environments and modern software development practices.
The ability to guide technical discussions and influence outcomes across multidisciplinary teams.
Master's or PhD degree in a relevant scientific or engineering discipline (or equivalent). For candidates with degrees obtained outside Belgium, a formal recognition process may be required as part of the hiring journey. Support will be provided.

Nice to have

You'll stand out if you have experience with:
Medical device software development.
Embedded or connected-device products.
Hardware-software integration testing.
Hardware-in-the-loop testing.
Test harnesses, simulation environments or mock frameworks.
Verification tooling, infrastructure and automation framework architecture.

Why join Cochlear?

At Cochlear, you'll have the opportunity to work on technology that genuinely improves people's lives while continuing to grow your technical expertise.

This role offers a pathway to becoming a leading specialist in software verification and automation, with opportunities to influence engineering standards, quality strategy and product outcomes on a global scale. You'll work alongside talented engineers in a collaborative environment that values innovation, knowledge sharing and continuous learning.

Bring your expertise. Help change lives.

Join a team where quality matters, innovation is encouraged and your technical leadership can make a real difference to the products we create and the people who rely on them.
